Agenda #1: Shareholders approved the appointment of Reno Bontemps, Houria Raselma, and Rianto Probo Hartono as Directors and confirmed the full composition of the Board of Directors and Board of Commissioners with terms ending in 2030. This resolution replaced outgoing directors Sergio Colarusso and Gunnar Beckers and granted them discharge from their positions.
Agenda #2: The Board of Directors and Corporate Secretary were authorized to restate the meeting resolutions in a notarial deed and perform all necessary administrative acts regarding the board appointments.

agm.agm_result:
Agenda #1: The meeting approved the 2025 Annual Report and Audited Consolidated Financial Statements, granting full discharge to the Board of Directors and Commissioners; the owner is Not stated.
Agenda #2: Shareholders approved a cash dividend of Rp56.3 per share from the 2025 fiscal year profit, with the owner Not stated.
Agenda #3: The meeting approved the appointment of KAP Rintis, Jumadi, Rianto & Rekan to audit the company's financial statements for the 2026 fiscal year; the owner is Not stated.
Agenda #4: Approval was granted to amend the Articles of Association to align business activities with the 2025 Indonesian Standard Industrial Classification; the owner is Not stated.
Agenda #5: The meeting confirmed the board composition until 2030 and accepted the resignation of Elvira Lianita; the owner is Not stated.
